remarks: It is unit #6. Prepared to be WOWED with this stunning, one-level condo with open floor plan, chef's kitchen, renovated baths and spacious master bedroom in sought-after Heywood Heights. Located in the Glenbrook section of Stamford, this meticulously updated 2 bedroom is conveniently located just 1 mile from the train station with close proximity to commuter routes. Heywood Heights is close to Stamford's vibrant downtown while still providing a picturesque private setting. Unleash your inner chef in the updated open kitchen with white cabinetry, granite countertops, over-sized island, SS GE Profile refrigerator, range and microwave, Bosch dishwasher and SS steel sink. Hardwood floors throughout. Living room is open to the kitchen and features a brick accent wall and double sliding doors that lead out to private deck surrounded by mature trees, stone walls and walking path. Both spacious bedrooms feature hardwood floors and closets complete with professional systems. Updated beautiful, spa like bathrooms. Newer washer/dryer in unit for convenience. Find additional private storage in the basement. The community is surrounded by beautiful, lush professional landscaping, walking paths, community pool and clubhouse. Stamford Dog Park just down the street. Make your home ownership dreams a reality!
